1. Open your Workspace Settings.
2. Navigate to the Billing section.
3. Review the Invoice history to locate your invoice.

If the invoice is still missing or you have concerns about a charge, please provide the invoice date and your ticket ID when contacting the billing team. Do not send full card details.

If you need further assistance, please let us know.
